strings.name: Ian Goodfellow
strings.summary: Goodfellow studies deep learning, generative models and machine-learning security. He proposed generative adversarial networks with collaborators and contributed to adversarial-example and privacy research. With Bengio and Courville he co-wrote Deep Learning. His career includes Google, OpenAI, Apple and DeepMind; a 2025 alumni interview described his fusion-simulation work.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Proposed generative adversarial networks and studied machine-learning security, influencing generative AI and deep-learning education.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: BS and MS in computer science, Stanford; PhD, Université de Montréal (2015).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Generative adversarial networks
strings.highlights.h1.text: With seven collaborators, proposed adversarial training of a generator and discriminator in 2014.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Deep-learning education
strings.highlights.h2.text: Co-authored the 2016 textbook Deep Learning with Bengio and Courville, with a free online edition.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Fusion simulation
strings.timeline.t1.text: Discussed fusion simulation and language-model factuality in a Mila alumni interview.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Joined DeepMind
strings.timeline.t2.text: After leaving Apple, joined DeepMind and worked on numerical simulation for fusion.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Apple machine learning
strings.timeline.t3.text: Directed machine learning in Apple’s Special Projects Group until 2022.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Returned to Google
strings.timeline.t4.text: Left OpenAI and returned to Google Research.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Published Deep Learning
strings.timeline.t5.text: Co-authored a systematic deep-learning textbook with Bengio and Courville.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joined OpenAI
strings.timeline.t6.text: Left Google to join the newly established AI research organization.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Doctorate
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed doctoral training in machine learning and representation learning at Montréal.
strings.timeline.t8.title: GAN framework
strings.timeline.t8.text: Published Generative Adversarial Networks with collaborators, introducing adversarial generative training.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Early machine-learning practice
strings.timeline.t9.text: Encountered automated EEG classification during a National Institutes of Health internship.
